enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.desc: Hunts in packs; goes for the slowest.

enemies.name: The Whisperwood Alpha
enemies.desc: A scarred grey giant that has led the pack for a decade.

enemies.name: Cave Spider
enemies.desc: Venom slows its prey.

enemies.name: Captain Vell of the Toll Bridge
Bog Wraith
enemies.desc: Blades pass through it; magic does not.

enemies.name: Barrow Wight
enemies.desc: Its touch drains warmth; fire undoes it.

enemies.name: Stone Golem
enemies.desc: Cracks when frozen.

enemies.name: Whisperwood Cave Bear
enemies.desc: Slow to anger, impossible to stop once it is.

enemies.name: Marsh Troll
enemies.desc: Its wounds close as you watch; fire keeps them open.

enemies.name: Barrow Wyvern
enemies.desc: Roosts on the high mounds; its tail-sting burns.

enemies.name: Hold Crossbowman
enemies.desc: Shoots from behind the palisade, then runs.

enemies.name: Hold War-hound
enemies.desc: Spiked collar, cropped ears, no fear.

enemies.name: Black Maud, Warlord of Raven's Hold
enemies.desc: She took the Hold from the king's men and has kept it eleven winters.

enemies.name: Drowned Acolyte
enemies.desc: Temple servants who never left when the waters came.

enemies.name: Temple Serpent
enemies.desc: Thick as a man's waist; it guards the pool it was fed in.

enemies.name: The Drowned Oracle
enemies.desc: She still answers questions. Nobody likes the answers.

enemies.name: Crag Harpy
enemies.desc: Shrieks first, dives second.

enemies.name: Ashen Drakeling
enemies.desc: A drake's whelp: small, hot-blooded and mean.

enemies.name: Cinderjaw, the Old Drake
enemies.desc: Older than the village. Its breath melts the snow on the crag.

enemies.name: Greyfang, the Young Alpha
enemies.desc: The old Alpha's get, grown into the hollow.

enemies.name: A Brood-Daughter
enemies.desc: One of the Brood Mother's eggs that did not burn.

enemies.name: Sergeant Hask of the Toll
enemies.desc: Vell's old sergeant, collecting the toll again.

enemies.name: The Wight-Steward
enemies.desc: The Wight-Lord's servant, keeping the barrow for a master who will not return.

enemies.name: The Hollow Warden
enemies.desc: A dwarf-built guardian that woke when its king fell.

enemies.name: Corvin Blackfeather
enemies.desc: Maud's lieutenant, regrouping what is left of her band.

enemies.name: The Oracle's Echo
enemies.desc: What is left of the Oracle's voice in the water.

enemies.name: Smoulderwing, a Young Drake
enemies.desc: Cinderjaw's last whelp, grown into the lair.

enemies.name: Starfall Wisp
enemies.desc: A shard of fallen starlight. Blades find little to cut; frost puts it out.

enemies.name: Orrery Sentinel
enemies.desc: Brass and starstone, still keeping the observatory's hours.

enemies.name: The Astral Warden
enemies.desc: Built to guard the great lens; it measures intruders the way it once measured stars.

enemies.name: A Shard of the Warden
enemies.desc: What the Warden left in the dome: smaller, slower, still sworn.

enemies.name: Weeping Legionary
enemies.desc: A soldier of a garrison that never stood down. They still keep formation.

enemies.name: Hollow Harness
enemies.desc: An empty suit of cursed plate that walks the armoury. Steel rings off it; spells do not.

enemies.name: Knight of the Weeping Banner
enemies.desc: Their tears are salt and their oaths are older than the village.

enemies.name: Marshal Ysolde, the Weeping Commander
enemies.desc: She held the fortress for a king who never came back, and holds it still.

enemies.name: Captain Orrin of the Weeping Banner
enemies.desc: The Marshal's captain, keeping her last order.

enemies.name: Blackglass Crawler
enemies.desc: Many-legged, glass-shelled; its bite cuts like a shard.

enemies.name: Rift Stalker
enemies.desc: Blind, patient, and drawn to the sound of breathing.

enemies.name: Abyssal Horror
enemies.desc: A shape the rift's darkness takes when it is hungry.

enemies.name: The Blackglass Maw
enemies.desc: The thing at the bottom of the rift. The glass grows from its breath.

enemies.name: A Maw-Brood
enemies.desc: The Maw's offspring, grown fat on what falls into the dark.

nodes.name: Herb glade
nodes.desc: Moonwort and emberleaf under the old oaks.

nodes.name: Bloodroot hollow
nodes.desc: Bloodroot, frostcap and silverleaf in the damp shade of the hollow.

nodes.name: Bear cave
nodes.desc: Bones at the mouth, and a smell like wet dog and old blood.

nodes.name: Troll's ford
nodes.desc: The ford nobody uses; the troll under it eats the ones who do.

barrow_fields.name: Barrow Fields
barrow_fields.theme: the old crypt: undead, traps, relics

nodes.name: Wyvern roost
nodes.desc: A wyvern nests on the tallest mound among stripped bones.

nodes.name: Troll warren
nodes.desc: Cave trolls den in the old smelting halls among hides and ore.

nodes.name: Ruined lookout
nodes.desc: An old royal watch-post; the bandits stash their take in it.

nodes.name: Plunder store
nodes.desc: Barrels, bolts of cloth and a caravan's worth of steel.

nodes.name: The muster yard
nodes.desc: Caltrops in the mud and a tripwire bell.

sunken_temple.name: The Sunken Temple
sunken_temple.theme: a drowned ruin in the marsh: the dead, serpents, relics

nodes.name: Lotus beds
nodes.desc: Pale lotus and bloodroot grow in the warm temple water.

drakes_crag.name: Drake's Crag
drakes_crag.theme: a drake's mountain: harpies, drakelings, a hoard

nodes.name: Obsidian scree
nodes.desc: Glassy black stone and ore cracked out by the drake's heat.

nodes.name: Field of bones
nodes.desc: Knights and sheep alike; some of the knights still have their purses.

starfall_observatory.name: The Starfall Observatory
starfall_observatory.theme: an abandoned arcane observatory: constructs, unstable starlight, a guardian

nodes.name: Collapsed lens-house
nodes.desc: Shattered lenses and starstone dust under the fallen roof.

nodes.name: The star library
nodes.desc: Sealed instrument cases and charts of skies nobody has seen for centuries.

nodes.name: The unstable gallery
nodes.desc: Raw starlight arcs between the brass rails; it burns whoever touches the wrong one.

nodes.name: The sealed astrolabe
nodes.desc: The dome's door turns when the rings are set to the right night.

weeping_fortress.name: The Weeping Fortress
weeping_fortress.theme: a haunted military fortress: elite undead, cursed armouries, a commander

nodes.name: The weeping chapel
nodes.desc: Salt tears run down the saint's face; the wounded find a little rest here.

nodes.name: The ossuary stair
nodes.desc: The stair gives way under the unwary, into the bones below.

nodes.name: The quartermaster's ward
nodes.desc: Pay-chests, banners and the garrison's best arms, under the Marshal's seal.

blackglass_rift.name: The Blackglass Rift
blackglass_rift.theme: a subterranean abyss: dreadful creatures, razor glass, the Maw

nodes.name: The glass descent
nodes.desc: Razor-glass scree: one slip opens a leg to the bone.

nodes.name: The ore shelf
nodes.desc: Veins of adamantine and orichalcum split open by the rift.

nodes.name: The echoing chasm
nodes.desc: The way across is a bridge of fallen glass that sings when it bears weight.

nodes.name: The glass garden
nodes.desc: Glass grown like coral around the bones of earlier delvers — and their packs.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.desc: Forgiving fights and prices; nobody dies — the fallen are carried home. Full live observation.

journeyman.name: Journeyman
journeyman.desc: Moderate risks; death is possible but rare. Live observation and detailed inspection.

master.name: Master
master.desc: High risk, tight money, real losses. No omniscient observation: you learn what happened when they come home.

whisperwood.desc: Old oak forest west of the village: herb glades, a ruined watchtower and the hollow where the Alpha dens.

cond.growing: The wolf packs are growing bold.
cond.regroup: Wolves howl again along the deer trail.
cond.cleared: The Alpha's hollow lies empty; the packs scatter without a leader.
cond.successor: A young alpha has taken the hollow.

ironroot_mine.desc: The broken quarry north of the village: dwarf-cut galleries, goblins, ore — and a spider nest in the deep end.
folk: old miners who still come for coal

cond.regroup: Goblins have crept back into the camp.
cond.cleared: The nest was burned out; only husks hang in the gallery.
cond.successor: A brood-daughter spins in the old nest.

highmarsh_road.desc: The trade road east to Highmarsh: a toll bridge, a bog, a troll's ford and Vell's hideout.

cond.growing: Bandits are thick on the road; carters travel only in convoys.
cond.regroup: The bandits are regrouping at the toll bridge.
cond.cleared: Vell's hideout stands empty; the carters breathe again.
cond.successor: Vell's old sergeant collects the toll again.

barrow_fields.desc: Burial mounds south of the village: grave rows, a rune door, the relic vault and the Wight-Lord's barrow.

cond.growing: The dead walk in numbers on the grave rows.
cond.regroup: Fresh tracks lead out of the open graves.
cond.cleared: The Wight-Lord's barrow lies broken open and silent.
cond.successor: The crypt was sealed again — something keeps it now.

deep_ironroot.desc: Below the old workings: crystal caverns, the golem forge and the Dwarf-King's hall. Found with the delve map.

cond.cleared: The Dwarf-King's hall is quiet; his crown-seat stands empty.
cond.successor: A warden of stone walks the Dwarf-King's hall.

ravens_hold.desc: A hillfort on the crags north of the Highmarsh road, taken from the king's men by Black Maud's band.

cond.growing: Maud's band grows; new faces at the palisade.
cond.regroup: The bandits are regrouping behind the wall.
cond.cleared: The Hold's hall is empty; ravens sit on the broken gate.
cond.successor: Corvin Blackfeather is regrouping the band in the Hold.

sunken_temple.desc: A drowned temple in the south-western marsh; its court and sanctum stand half under water.

cond.growing: The drowned rise thicker each night.
cond.regroup: Something stirs in the flooded court again.
cond.cleared: The sanctum water lies still; the Oracle is silent.
cond.successor: An echo of the Oracle whispers in the sanctum.

drakes_crag.desc: A smoking crag in the north-western mountains where an old drake sleeps on a hoard.
folk: goatherds who will not go above the treeline

cond.growing: Drakelings hatch in the ash vents.
cond.regroup: Harpies are back on the nests.
cond.cleared: Cinderjaw's lair is cold; its hoard is gone.
cond.successor: A young drake has taken the old lair.

starfall_observatory.desc: An abandoned arcane observatory on a crag south-east of the Highmarsh road; its great lens still turns at night.
folk: stargazers who camp below and never climb

cond.growing: Wisps gather thicker in the dome each night.
cond.cleared: The great lens is dark; the Astral Warden lies in pieces.
cond.successor: A shard of the Warden keeps the dome.

weeping_fortress.desc: A haunted fortress in the far western hills, still garrisoned by soldiers who died at their posts.
folk: pilgrims who leave salt at the gate

cond.growing: More of the garrison stands to arms each night.
cond.regroup: Drums again on the weeping walls.
cond.cleared: The Marshal has fallen; the keep is silent at last.
cond.successor: Captain Orrin has taken up the Marshal's watch.

blackglass_rift.desc: A black abyss in the southern badlands, its walls grown with razor glass. Few who go down come back with their packs.
folk: prospectors who listen at the rim

cond.growing: The crawlers swarm higher up the walls.
cond.regroup: Something large moves in the deep again.
cond.cleared: The Maw is dead; the glass has stopped growing.
cond.successor: A Maw-Brood has grown fat in the deep.
